name: Tsuki Tasogare
source:
Saturday's missing sister.

[spoiler] One of four parts of Saturday split off in the Severance of Emotion. Described in-game as the "flight" in "fight or flight." Her "fight" counterpart is Dawn Hisomeru.[/spoiler]
